E1.label: Environmental Impact Reduction
E1.summary: Reduces environmental impact and is supported by a qualified life cycle study (LCS) or quantitative life cycle assessment (LCA).
E1.description: The project strategy includes at least one action to reduce environmental impact that is supported by a qualified life cycle study (LCS) or quantitative life cycle assessment (LCA).
E1.whyItMatters: Actions lead to designs with a lower impact.

E3.label: Product Ingredients Transparency
E3.description: The project includes a list of all components and/or ingredients.
E3.whyItMatters: The display of “ingredients” or material components.

E4.label: Ink, Printing, and Finishes
E4.summary: Reduces ink coverage on printed materials.
E4.description: The project reduces or eliminates the use of inks, varnishes and finishes, or requires no printing.
E4.whyItMatters: Reduces ink coverage on printed materials.

E5.label: Paper
E5.description: The project reduces paper use through efficiencies.
E5.whyItMatters: Efficient use of paper and reduces paper use.

E6.label: Product Quantity
E6.description: Reproduction is limited to immediate needs, including the possibility that no physical copies were needed.

E7.label: Durability & Extended Life
E7.summary: Integrates extended-life durability through reuse, repair, recharge, and/or upgrade where appropriate.
E7.description: The product or system is physically durable and has a longer life than the industry average, where desirable. The product or system can be reused, recharged, repaired, and/or upgraded as an environmental benefit.
E7.whyItMatters: Product design for longer life than the industry average.

E9.label: Toxins
E9.description: The project reduces or eliminates the use of toxins.
E9.whyItMatters: Reduces or eliminates toxins in a product.

E10.label: Environmental Policy
E10.description: The design entity and a majority of suppliers have publicly-accessible environmental policies.

EM4.label: Animal Welfare
EM4.description: To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project, the design entity, and the client's activities do not, and will not, put animals at risk.
EM4.whyItMatters: Animals are not at risk from this project.

EM6.label: Ecosystems Conservation
EM6.description: To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project, the design entity, and the client's activities do not, and will not, support the destruction of ecosystems.

E14.label: Recyclability or Reusability
E14.description: Materials or systems used increase the ease and likelihood of recycling and/or reuse of the product and its packaging.
E14.whyItMatters: Product and packaging can be reused or recycled.

E17.label: Non-Renewable Resources
E17.summary: Reduces non-renewable natural resources and materials.
E17.description: The project reduces or eliminates the use of scarce, non-renewable natural resources and raw materials.
E17.whyItMatters: Strategies reduce the use of non-renewable natural resources.

E15.label: Biological or Organic Materials
E15.summary: Uses waste as a nutrient or fuel, or is compostable.
E15.description: The product can be used as fuel or food, or composted, either locally composted by the end user or incorporated into a local energy-recovery system that does not involve landfill or thermal treatment.
E15.whyItMatters: The product can be composted or used as fuel or food.

E13.label: Zero Waste
E13.description: The final product is a "zero waste" product.

E16.label: Renewable Energy
E16.description:
P: The production of the product uses renewable energy from solar, wind, thermal or tidal sources.

C: The design entity uses renewable energy from solar, wind, thermal or tidal sources.
E16.whyItMatters: Clean energy sources were used to make the product.

E18.label: Consumer Energy Efficiency
E18.description: The product or system used by the consumer is energy efficient or uses renewable energy.

energy-efficiency.label: Energy Efficiency
energy-efficiency.summary: Maximizes the product or the system's energy efficiency.
energy-efficiency.description: The product or system used by the consumer is energy efficient or uses renewable energy.

E19.label: Storage and Transportation
E19.description: The project includes shipping and/or warehousing efficiencies to optimize storage and transportation.

E11.label: Quantified GHG Reporting and Certification
E11.summary: Displays a publicly-accessible report of emissions, materials use, and waste.
E11.description:
P: The project has a publicly-accessible quantified report of GHG reductions and/or energy, material use and waste disposal.

C: The design entity has a publicly-accessible quantified report of GHG reductions and/or energy, material use and waste disposal.
E11.whyItMatters: Publicly-accessible reporting of materials, waste and emissions.

E21.label: Air Pollution
E21.description:
P: The project reduces or avoids air pollution.

C: The design entity reduces or avoids air pollution.

E22.label: Carbon Offsets
E22.summary: Offsets travel, production, and web presence emissions through carbon credit purchases.
E22.description:
P: The project offsets all GHG emissions for travel, production and Web presence.

C: The design entity offsets all GHG emissions for travel, production and Web presence.
E22.whyItMatters: Carbon credits offset travel, production and Web presence.

E23.label: Water
E23.summary: Reduces or eliminates water use and water pollution.
E23.description: Water pollution or water use were avoided or reduced.

sound-light-pollution.label: Sound & Light Pollution
sound-light-pollution.summary: Reduces or eliminates sound and light pollution.
sound-light-pollution.description:
P: The project avoids or reduces sound and light pollution.

C: The design entity avoids or reduces sound and light pollution.

odor-scent-fragrance.label: Odor, Scent and Fragrance
odor-scent-fragrance.description:
P: The project is odor, scent, and fragrance-free.

C: The design entity has a no odor, scent, or fragrance policy.

S1.label: Harmless
S1.summary: Reduces injury in the making and use of the product.
S1.description: The project reduces mental and physical injury to those who produce or use the product.
S1.whyItMatters: Reduces injury in the making and use of the product.

S2.label: Health and Safety
S2.description: The project improves the health or safety of the target audience.

S3.label: Local Labour
S3.description: The project significantly increases the amount of locally sourced labour from the end users' location.

SM1.label: Human Rights
SM1.subcategoryLabel: Ethical Practices in Design and Production
SM1.description:
P: To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project and the client's activities are not directly or indirectly involved in the violation of universal human rights.

C: The design entity does not contribute directly or indirectly to the violation of universal human rights.
SM1.whyItMatters: Design does not contribute to the violation of human rights.

SM2.label: Corruption
SM2.subcategoryLabel: Ethical Practices in Design and Production
SM2.summary: Upholds high standards of anti-corruption and ethical governance.
SM2.description:
P: To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project and the client's activities are not directly or indirectly involved in corruption or unethical governance.

C: The design entity is not involved in corruption or unethical governance.
SM2.whyItMatters: Corruption was not identified in the project.

SM3.label: Rights of Workers
SM3.subcategoryLabel: Ethical Practices in Design and Production
SM3.description: To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project and the client's activities are not directly or indirectly involved in the violation of the fundamental principles and rights of workers.

S10.label: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
S10.subcategoryLabel: Ethical Practices in Design and Production
S10.summary: Discloses design sources as human-made or AI generated, and adheres to ethical guidelines.
S10.description: The project discloses the sources of design whether human made or AI generated. If AI was used to create any part of a design, it follows UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence.
S10.whyItMatters: Authentically created design by a person.

S6.label: Electronic Documents
S6.summary: Ensures accessibility of all electronic documents, including Web pages.
S6.description: All electronic documents comply with the W3C WCAG 2.0 Level A standard, or higher, or comply with the ISO standard for PDF/UA accessibility standard.
S6.whyItMatters: Accessibility of all electronic documents, including Web pages.

S6b.label: Printed Documents and Compliance
S6b.summary: Ensures accessibility of all printed materials.
S6b.description: Printed materials are designed using accessible typography, contrast, hierarchy, and readability principles to support users with visual, cognitive, or literacy-related accessibility needs.

S8.label: Universal Design Principles
S8.description: The non-document components of the project adhere to universal design principles.

S9.label: Intellectual Property
S9.summary: Uses a clear and responsible intellectual property approach.
S9.description: The project clearly defines and respects intellectual property ownership, authorship, permissions, licensing, and usage rights. Where appropriate, the project may also share reusable intellectual property through Creative Commons or another open licensing approach that creates value for society.
S9.whyItMatters: Clear intellectual property ownership, permissions, licensing, and usage rights protect creators, users, clients, and the public value of reusable design work.

S11.label: Affordable
S11.summary: Maintains affordability for all market sectors.
S11.description: The product is affordable to a wide audience including those with limited financial resources.
S11.whyItMatters: Sustainable products are affordable for all market sectors.

S12.label: Fair Trade
S12.summary: Ensures collaborations between low, middle and high income countries.
S12.description: The project involves "fair trade" to ensure equity between low, middle and high income countries.
S12.whyItMatters: Collaborations between low, middle and high income countries.

S13.label: Social Gaps
S13.summary: Reduces gaps in gender, power, and wealth.
S13.description: The project aims to close gaps of gender, power, or wealth within and across social, economic, and political systems.
S13.whyItMatters: Reduces wealth and power gaps inside and between countries.

S14.label: Freedom of Expression
S14.summary: Encourages freedom of expression and/or democracy.
S14.description: The project encourages or educates about democracy and/or freedom of expression.
S14.whyItMatters: Encourages freedom of expression and/or democracy.

S15.label: Design Education
S15.summary: Provides design education opportunities for students.
S15.description: The project includes design students and/or enriches existing design school curriculum.
S15.whyItMatters: Provides design education opportunities for students.

S16.label: Educational Component
S16.summary: Educates the user or consumer on sustainability.
S16.description: The product includes an educational component that promotes sustainability to the consumer.
S16.whyItMatters: Educates the user or consumer on sustainability.

C2.label: Endangered Languages
C2.summary: Contributes to the protection of endangered languages.
C2.description: The project helps to preserve endangered languages, particularly Indigenous languages.
C2.whyItMatters: Contributes to the preservation of endangered languages.

C3.label: Indigenous Culture
C3.description: The project preserves or nurtures Indigenous culture other than language.

C4.label: Local Culture
C4.description: The project adapts to local and regional cultures.

C5.label: Cultural Diversity
C5.description: The project promotes or enhances cultural diversity.
C5.whyItMatters: Design promotes or enhances cultural diversity.

CM9.label: Cultural Policy
CM9.description: The design entity and the majority of suppliers have a publicly-accessible policy to actively protect and support communities.

C6.label: Audience Engagement
C6.summary: Engages with end users and audiences.
C6.description: The project engages end users throughout the design process or audiences that will be directly impacted by the project.
C6.whyItMatters: Design process engages with end user.

C7.label: Community Participation
C7.summary: Supports the sustainable development of the design entity's community.
C7.description: The design entity actively supports and participates in the sustainable development of their community.
C7.whyItMatters: Actively supports the sustainable development of your community.

C8.label: Practitioners' Education
C8.description: The project results in the education of sustainability for design practitioners.
C8.whyItMatters: Project educates others to support sustainable design education.

F1.label: Economic Benefits
F1.summary: Adds value that benefits a region's economy.
F1.description: The project identifies and creates economic benefits beyond benefits to the client and the design entity.
F1.whyItMatters: Adds value to benefit a region’s economy.

F2.label: Profitability
F2.summary: Ensures the design entity is paid for work performed.
F2.description: The project budget or contract financially compensates the design entity.
F2.whyItMatters: The designing entity profits from the project.

FM3.label: Unpaid Work
FM3.description: The design entity and the project did not request unpaid work, also known as "free pitching", "speculative work", or "spec work", from designers, including interns and student designers.
FM3.whyItMatters: All design work is financially compensated.

F4.label: SMART Goals
F4.subcategoryLabel: Economic Accountability and Strategic Value / Financial Planning
F4.summary: Outlines financial objectives in the design brief.
F4.description: A project document exists that establishes SMART financial objectives with clear, measurable targets and time-bound outcomes.
F4.whyItMatters: Financial objectives are defined in a design brief.

F5.label: Accountability and Transparency
F5.subcategoryLabel: Economic Accountability and Strategic Value / Financial Planning
F5.summary: Adheres to transparent financial management and documentation practices.
F5.description: Adheres to transparent financial management and documentation practices.

F6.label: Standards Improvement
F6.subcategoryLabel: Economic Accountability and Strategic Value / Financial Planning
F6.summary: Improves the standards and procedures of the design entity.
F6.description: The project improves the design entity's documented standards and procedures.
F6.whyItMatters: Continuous improvement in the designing entity’s organization.

F7.label: Design Thinking
F7.subcategoryLabel: Economic Accountability and Strategic Value / Financial Planning
F7.summary: Adds business value through design strategy.
F7.description: Design thinking adds economic value to audiences, users, and/or stakeholders.
F7.whyItMatters: Adds value to a business through design strategy.
